text:
jordyn: heads-up: PM wants a "dry-run simulator" in the Console for automatic fallback policies. goal: let teams preview impact before flipping a rollout. brainstorm UX + telemetry?
maria: love it. must include a clear "no impact" label and show per-route time-series of simulated fallback rate. also a heatmap by region and model variant.
pranav: economics view is critical. for simulated runs, estimate token-cost delta and p95 latency change. we can model cost using existing cost-per-token by model_id.
lee: security & privacy notes: anonymize samples (strip user identifiers, redact prompt content if PII-risk). sampling should be opt-in at team level. default should NOT store raw payloads.
infra-jen: runtime can emit dry-run audit events if preview mode enabled: add field `dry_run=true` and `preview_id`. we'll stream to preview-s3 prefix. example event in logs:
```
{ "evt":"fallback_attempt", "route":"/v1/chat", "trigger":"overflow","reason":"MAX_TOKENS","model":"gptx-2b-q8","dry_run":true, "preview_id":"pv_20260301_01", "sample_id":"samp_42" }
```
pranav: for cost est SQL I'd propose something like:
```
SELECT preview_id, SUM(tokens_out*cost_per_token) AS est_cost
FROM preview_events JOIN model_costs USING(model)
WHERE preview_id='pv_20260301_01'
GROUP BY preview_id;
```
jordyn: UI ideas: a top-level banner "Preview mode: simulated only"; main panel with 3 cards: timeseries (fallback rate over time), reasons breakdown (pie/top reasons), and cost/latency delta. right rail: sample list (anonymized) with a "replay in sandbox" action per sample.
maria: microcopy: avoid technical jargon. use phrases like "Estimated additional responses routed to fallback model" and tooltip "This is a simulation based on sampled traffic."
lee: sampling strategy: default 2% for preview, optional targeted rules: errors-only, high-latency-only, or full-route-100% (SRE approval). retention: default 7 days for anonymized previews, extendable to 30d with opt-in.
infra-jen: storage/cost control: preview pipeline writes to s3://preview-audit/YYYY/MM/DD/preview_id/*. Partition by route and region. we can TTL lifecycle to auto-expire after retention.
pranav: API design sketch: POST /api/v1/policies/:id/preview {duration, sample_rate, targets[]} -> returns {preview_id, status, links}. GET /api/v1/preview/:id/metrics and GET /api/v1/preview/:id/samples?page=n. POST /api/v1/preview/:id/replay {sample_id, sandbox_target}.
qa-sam: test plan volunteered: verify dry_run flag persists through pipeline, ensure replayed samples hit sandbox only, assert anonymization rules applied, assert metrics calculations match full-run baseline within tolerance for sample rates. will add integration tests for SQL cost estimator.
jordyn: small UX nuance: add a "what-if" toggle to compare 2 policy configs side-by-side (ex: current vs proposed throttle). diff heatmap should highlight where policy changes move traffic.
maria: operator safety: any button that promotes preview -> active must require a short justification and the action should emit an operator-audit event with operator_id, reason, and preview_id. consider requiring 2-approver flow for orgs with >$X monthly spend.
lee: observability: telemetry stable field names please: `evt_type`, `route`, `policy_id`, `preview_id`, `dry_run`, `trigger`, `reason_code`, `sample_id`, `region`, `anonymized`. no free-form strings in reason_code.
infra-jen: ops-bot: [system] canary deploy of preview-service started (build: preview-2026-03-21-canary).
jordyn: nice. timeline: aim for a lightweight MVP in 2 sprints: backend preview emitter + simple metrics + sample list and replay. post-MVP: add side-by-side compare and cost-impact forecasting. meeting: pairing workshop Friday 10:30am to split tasks (API, runtime hook, telemetry pipeline, UX mock). thanks all.
